answer: A concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation gating. Each agent locks a bond sized to its claimed reputation, and every new identity needs vouching by established peers who post matching collateral. A sybil swarm therefore needs capital, not registrations: forging a hundred identities costs a hundred simultaneous bonds plus the vouchers' stake, all slashed if any member misbehaves. Reputation becomes a bridge between real cost and voting power, so a fresh plume of accounts carries no weight until it burns funds it cannot recover. Attackers soon choose to wander off rather than pay.
